static_traits.name: Lin Wen
static_traits.family_status: 与四个兄弟姐妹及任教的Mother共同居住在一套公寓中
static_traits.social_status: 有家庭支持资源(Mother与兄弟姐妹),但尚not yet与家人讨论困扰;人际情况Not disclosed
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病;此前not yet接受心理治疗;与艺术相关的类似问题既往not yet出现
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,配合度尚可,但语气消极;常use绝对化与negate性表述(如'I am not good enough''应该放弃');Skeptical about positive feedback

basic_info.main_problem: 与绘画相关的Sense of frustration与失败感:认为自己without法卖出作品,因而动摇继续创作的意愿,出现放弃的念头;看到其他Artist获得成功与赞誉时加重Self-doubt与Depression.
basic_info.core_demands: Negative thoughts and feelings have begun to affect creative motivation and cause distress, affecting daily life, so she seeks counseling to relieve these troubles.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough(作为Artist)
The value of my work (and my value) depends on external recognition and sales

special_situations.event: 长期not yet能卖出任何作品
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果作品have not售出,就说明它have not价值,I am just a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 将创作价值强行与销量绑定;在持续not yet售出时考虑停止创作以避免进一步失败
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 卖not出去就证明我很差,我应该放弃

special_situations.event: 看到其他Artist在社交媒体上发布成功与获赞
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果达not到他们的水平或赞誉,就说明I am not good enough,not会成功
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断与他人比较,加倍练习以试图证明自己;当比较后仍感到not如他人时倾向于Withdrawal或想要放弃
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远达not到他们那样的水平

special_situations.event: Friends giving positive reviews of one's work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 正面反馈not算数,只有销量或广泛认可才是真实评价
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate赞美,忽略正面线索,只保留与失败一致的证据
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们只是客套,我的作品其实not值钱

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果最终卖not出去,这次创作就是浪费时间
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在开工前Self-denial,降低投入或拖延甚至停止创作,以减少'Meaninglessness感'与失败感
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: not人会买这幅画,做了也是白做

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被看见与被认可,作为Artist获得价值与成就感
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被negate与失败,担心自己永远达not到他人标准,被视为not够好
defense_goal: 通过Withdrawal,negate正面反馈,将价值与销量绑定来降低被羞辱与失败的风险

object_relations.self_representation: not被看见,容易失败的创作者
object_relations.object_representation: Picky others/audiences who only recognize sales and fame

object_relations.self_representation: A dependent who needs external proof of worth
object_relations.object_representation: 可能轻视或not理解自己的他人(如线上观众,潜在买家)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师探问并Reinforcement朋友的正面反馈,邀请来访者考虑其真实性与意义时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将他人的赞美理解为not真诚或与现实(not yet售出)not符
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use怀疑与negate的语气,强调'他们只是客套',对赞美保持距离.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests exploring the value of art beyond sales (such as creating for loved ones)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将'not以销售为目标'的创作理解为have not意义,not值得投入
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 用因果式,绝对化表述强调'如果not卖就not价值',语气坚决以维持既有信念.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked whether they are willing to share current emotional distress and creative pressure with family
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 预设家人会认为自己的困扰'幼稚/not重要',从而选择not表达
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Keeps silent or understates, avoids unfolding feeling details, tone is restrained.

manifestations: Binds the value of art entirely to sales and external praise
When starting a new work, feels 'doing it is in vain anyway'
Difficulty accepting positive feedback,认为not卖出就not值钱
outcomes: 创作过程由愉悦转为压力与Meaninglessness感

manifestations: 虽然拥有家庭支持资源,但选择not与Mother及兄弟姐妹分享困扰
When comparing with others' success on social media, self-isolation and inferiority intensify
outcomes: Lacks realistic emotional support and corrective experiences

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Directly takes the social standard 'only what sells has value' as the sole standard for measuring oneself and one's work
Defining self-worth by sales and praise

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 认为朋友的赞美只是客套,not真诚
把内心的Self-doubt与not配感Projection为他人对自己的轻视

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 频繁自责与Self-denial('I am not good enough')
Overly cautious about sharing troubles, carefully avoids seeking help

positive_force: Stable love of painting and practice commitment (long-term practice)
具备潜在的家庭支持资源(Mother与四位兄弟姐妹)
negative_force: Excessively relying on external validation (sales and praise) to define worth
与他人比较引发的自卑与despair
非黑即白思维导致将'not yet售出'与'失败'直接等同
negate正面反馈,只保留负面证据(心理过滤与negate积极)
Making negative predictions when starting to create, increasing stress and avoidance

target_behavior.behavior: 在创作相关情境中出现强烈的Self-denial与放弃念头
antecedent: 看到其他Artist在社交媒体上发布成功与获赞
长时间not yet能售出作品
target_behavior.core_reason: 将自我价值与作品销量绑定,受比较与despair,非黑即白思维驱动;为避免羞耻与失败而倾向Withdrawal
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在的失败与被negate,短期缓解Anxiety与羞耻
target_behavior.consequence: 创作Decreased motivation,投入减少,Low mood与Intensifying self-doubt

target_behavior.behavior: 回避求助与表达情绪困扰(not与家人讨论)
antecedent: Thinking about family's possible views or reactions
target_behavior.core_reason: 对他人反应的负性预测与读心(担心被轻视),伴随羞耻感与Self-denial
target_behavior.function: Avoids being judged and emotional exposure, maintaining surface safety
target_behavior.consequence: 缺乏现实支持与修正性反馈,Increased sense of isolation,Negative emotions persisting

target_behavior.behavior: negate积极反馈,将赞美解读为not真诚
antecedent: Friends' positive comments and encouragement on the work
target_behavior.core_reason: 负性核心信念'I am not good enough'与外部验证偏好导致的认知偏差(negate积极,心理过滤)
target_behavior.function: Maintains a negative self-schema to avoid cognitive dissonance
target_behavior.consequence: 自尊进一步受损,正向线索without法内化,抑郁与Anxiety水平上升
